description: Exercise #12 heat retreat motion, #14 delayed heat re-entry and #55 emergency travel in heating air. A broad living-room ignition has a 60 s head start; the secondary foyer crate ignites 20 s after entry. Evidence is retreat/emergency_exit with air_temp.txt, followed by motion; heat_again after any reenter. 55 s allows the unchanged 30 s heat-exit wait. Re-entry is contingent on observed cooling, not forced.
duration_s_reason: Test observation window; also the existing recorder operating deadline. Meeting and heat re-entry require their full physical waiting periods.

fire.head_start_s_reason: Fire age when robots reach the launch pads. Zero for delayed ignition, 6 s to develop a local flame, 60 s for a heated compartment.
fire.config_file_reason: World-only fuel ignition experiment. Heat and smoke load the same file.
